title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
hook_text: Mistral dropped a trillion-parameter AI model.
script:
Mistral dropped a trillion-parameter AI model.
The Paris lab released open weights for the massive system.
It targets enterprise cybersecurity and network defense.
Organizations gain direct control that closed models block.
Companies can inspect and modify the raw weights themselves.
This counters security risks tied to black box systems.
Would you trust an open model with your firewall?
